task.title: Disabling the Route component
task.shortdesc: To prevent the Red Hat Quay Operator from creating a route, you can set the route component to unmanaged in the QuayRegistry custom resource. You must then configure SSL/TLS handling in your config.yaml file.

step.cmd: In your quayregistry.yaml file, set the route component as managed: false:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: quay.redhat.com/v1 kind: QuayRegistry metadata: name: example-registry namespace: quay-enterprise spec: components: - kind: route managed: false
